# AchReactive

> 데이터 조합으로 모든 게임 콘텐츠를 만드는 도메인 무관 리액션 프레임워크.

## Others

- [API reference](/AchReactive/en/api.md): Key classes and signatures.
- [Changelog](/AchReactive/en/changelog.md): AchReactive release notes.
- [Getting started](/AchReactive/en/getting-started.md): From installing AchReactive to running your first reaction.
- [Authoring tools](/AchReactive/en/usage/authoring-tools.md): The UIToolkit-based Type Designer and Data Editor.
- [Core concepts](/AchReactive/en/usage/concepts.md): Triggers, conditions, effects, and the domain-agnostic data model.
- [Data and sources](/AchReactive/en/usage/data-sources.md): IData, DataBase, and JSON, CSV, and custom loaders.
- [Extending](/AchReactive/en/usage/extending.md): New behaviors, new domains, and cross-domain connections.
- [Reactions and default behaviors](/AchReactive/en/usage/reactions.md): The ReactionEngine execution flow and the provided effects, conditions, and triggers.
